LLL.d11.s0.sentence: In addition to controlling transcription of PROTEIN0, PROTEIN1 appears to control expression of at least one other gene required for production of CSF.
LLL.d11.s0.orig_sentence: In addition to controlling transcription of phrC, sigmaH appears to control expression of at least one other gene required for production of CSF.

LLL.d13.s0.sentence: Production of PROTEIN0 about 1 h earlier than normal does affect PROTEIN1, which when phosphorylated is an activator of PROTEIN2 transcription.
LLL.d13.s0.orig_sentence: Production of sigmaK about 1 h earlier than normal does affect Spo0A, which when phosphorylated is an activator of sigE transcription.

LLL.d13.s1.sentence: The PROTEIN0 promoter, like the PROTEIN1 promoter, is believed to be recognized by PROTEIN2 RNA polymerase, suggesting that PROTEIN3 may inhibit PROTEIN4 activity late in sporulation.
LLL.d13.s1.orig_sentence: The ald promoter, like the sigE promoter, is believed to be recognized by sigmaA RNA polymerase, suggesting that sigmaK may inhibit sigmaA activity late in sporulation.

LLL.d13.s2.sentence: In the mother cell compartment of sporulating cells, expression of the PROTEIN0 gene, encoding the earlier-acting sigma factor, sigmaE, is negatively regulated by the later-acting sigma factor, PROTEIN1.
LLL.d13.s2.orig_sentence: In the mother cell compartment of sporulating cells, expression of the sigE gene, encoding the earlier-acting sigma factor, sigmaE, is negatively regulated by the later-acting sigma factor, sigmaK.

LLL.d28.s0.sentence: Primer extension experiments and Northern blot analysis show that an active PROTEIN0-dependent promoter precedes PROTEIN1 and transcription is terminated at the putative p-independent terminator downstream of kdgT.
LLL.d28.s0.orig_sentence: Primer extension experiments and Northern blot analysis show that an active sigmaA-dependent promoter precedes kdgR and transcription is terminated at the putative p-independent terminator downstream of kdgT.

LLL.d30.s0.sentence: We overproduced and purified sigma(X) from Escherichia coli and demonstrate that in vitro, both PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 holoenzymes recognize promoter elements within the PROTEIN2-PROTEIN3 control region.
LLL.d30.s0.orig_sentence: We overproduced and purified sigma(X) from Escherichia coli and demonstrate that in vitro, both sigma(A) and sigma(X) holoenzymes recognize promoter elements within the sigX-ypuN control region.

LLL.d34.s0.sentence: However, the mutant was unable to stimulate transcription by final PROTEIN0-RNA polymerase from the PROTEIN1-dependent PROTEIN2 operon promoter.
LLL.d34.s0.orig_sentence: However, the mutant was unable to stimulate transcription by final sigma(A)-RNA polymerase from the Spo0A-dependent spoIIG operon promoter.

LLL.d35.s0.sentence: The Bacillus subtilis PROTEIN0 operon is regulated by two stress induction pathways relying on either PROTEIN1 or a class III stress induction mechanism acting at a PROTEIN2-like promoter.
LLL.d35.s0.orig_sentence: The Bacillus subtilis clpC operon is regulated by two stress induction pathways relying on either sigmaB or a class III stress induction mechanism acting at a sigmaA-like promoter.

LLL.d35.s1.sentence: Our data demonstrate that the PROTEIN0 protein acts as a global repressor of the PROTEIN1 operon, as well as other class III heat shock genes, by preventing unstressed transcription from either the PROTEIN2- or PROTEIN3-dependent promoter and might be inactivated or dissociate under inducing stress conditions.
LLL.d35.s1.orig_sentence: Our data demonstrate that the CtsR protein acts as a global repressor of the clpC operon, as well as other class III heat shock genes, by preventing unstressed transcription from either the sigmaB- or sigmaA-dependent promoter and might be inactivated or dissociate under inducing stress conditions.

LLL.d37.s0.sentence: Therefore, PROTEIN0 is solely expressed during sporulation from a PROTEIN1- and PROTEIN2-controlled promoter that is located immediately upstream of ftsY inside the smc gene.
LLL.d37.s0.orig_sentence: Therefore, ftsY is solely expressed during sporulation from a sigma(K)- and GerE-controlled promoter that is located immediately upstream of ftsY inside the smc gene.

LLL.d38.s0.sentence: In that respect PROTEIN0 is similar to the previously described gene PROTEIN1 which is also a member of the PROTEIN2 regulon.
LLL.d38.s0.orig_sentence: In that respect sigB is similar to the previously described gene gsiB which is also a member of the sigmaB regulon.

LLL.d43.s0.sentence: The PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 genes are recognized primarily by the forespore-specific sigma factor for RNA polymerase, PROTEIN2; the PROTEIN3-PROTEIN4 operon is recognized equally well by PROTEIN5 and the other forespore-specific sigma factor, PROTEIN6.
LLL.d43.s0.orig_sentence: The sspH and sspL genes are recognized primarily by the forespore-specific sigma factor for RNA polymerase, sigmaG; the sspN-tlp operon is recognized equally well by sigmaG and the other forespore-specific sigma factor, sigmaF.
